drawerContent.title: Workflow-Driven.
drawerContent.description: Structure complex products around clear workflows, making processes, relationships, and interactions easier to understand without unnecessary complexity.

drawerContent.title: Reusable Sections.
drawerContent.description: Build flexible, composable layouts with modular sections that adapt across pages, products, and content needs, making it easier to create consistent experiences without rebuilding the same patterns.

drawerContent.title: Design Foundations.
drawerContent.description: Connect shared design foundations across interfaces and code to maintain visual consistency, speed up iteration, and create a reliable system that can evolve alongside the product and team.

drawerContent.title: Production Ready.
drawerContent.description: Move from early concepts to polished experiences with scalable architecture, responsive interfaces, and maintainable frontend code built for long-term growth.
